description.value: Sapporo Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in Deep Cove specializing in oshi sushi, ramen, and yakisoba, situated at the end of a popular North Shore cycling destination on Indian Arm. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout with online ordering via website or app, making it a convenient refuel stop after a coastal ride. The team also handles catering for larger groups and special occasions.
